evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'You book online this call will just take around five to ten minutes. Will that be fine?' — no framing of time-boxed ask + promise of dependable quote, no real wait for yes before diving into details.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep immediately probes logistics: 'You're moving on Saturday October 10th from a one bedroom apartment...' with no prior discovery of concerns or what the customer wants answers to.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives range ($666 to $888 for 3–4 hours) but does not personalize it to anything specific about this customer's move — no reference to their stated preferences, concerns, or readiness level.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep delivers pricing and immediately continues: 'and keep in mind we are a time based company...' with no pause or confirmation check.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not mentioned. Rep covers damage coverage ('no worries, damage coverage, we provide up to $2,000 per move') but never delivers the On-Time Guarantee.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Covered: 'included in the hourly rate. We have no worries, damage coverage, we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages' — but missing no-deductible/no-fine-print framing.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'do you have any questions or anything for me?' — this is the throwaway empty-out version, not a genuine 'what's still concerning you?' check.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep confirms details and closes with 'And we'll see you again on Saturday October 10th' — no direct ask for the business ('Would you like our help with your move?'), and no rate-lock mentioned.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (Saturday October 10th), phone (512-960-6540), arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM), addresses (both pickup and drop-off). Missing: crew size confirmation and notes left for crew about customer concerns.

top_strength: Nicole gathered all core logistics details (property type, floor, walking distance, special items, box count, parking) efficiently and cleanly, and correctly explained the time-based pricing model and damage coverage inclusion without confusion.
coaching_note: Start every call with the quid-pro-quo framing ('we have availability, this takes 10–15 minutes, you walk away with a quote you can depend on — sound good?'), ask their agenda before any probing, and always ask 'Does that feel fair?' with a real pause before moving to Two Promises — you're currently jumping straight into logistics and skipping the permission-to-continue that keeps customers engaged.
